worklist: step 3: US-market trims sold only with a manual transmission

method.claim: A trim is listed as manual-only for the stated US model years only. Years in which the trim name also came with an automatic are excluded and listed in not_manual_only.
method.identification: Only from the VIN decode (vPIC Trim/Series exact match, vPIC model name, vPIC engine displacement where it is unique to the trim) or a VIN pattern whose meaning is cited (Part 565 filing or vPIC pattern decode). feed_model only where the yard's model name IS the trim (S2000, Viper, Lancer Evolution 2003-2006, Golf R, R32, GR Corolla). Blobs naming several trims never match.

status.verified: two independent sources (EPA counts when its rows isolate the trim); counted
status.single_source: one source only; listed, not counted
status.covered_by_step2_rule: a step-2 VIN rule already covers the trim and is the counted rule; listed for completeness, not double counted

method.validation: Every identifier is applied to ground_truth.jsonl. uniformCell lines are unlabelled (BASELINE.md section 2). Note: VIN-bearing ground truth is vPIC's own TransmissionStyle, so agreement on Honda/Acura/Subaru checks the trim table against Honda's/Subaru's VIN transmission codes, not against an independent observation.
method.counting: Lot cars matched by a verified trim whose published transmission (extras trans) is empty, excluding yards in Canada (US-market claims). also_confirmed_by_step2 marks cars a step-2 rule already confirms.
method.sources_read: Wikipedia read as raw wikitext (en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?action=raw) through the session proxy on 2026-11-05; other pages through web-search result text or a plain page fetch the same day.

decode_cache_check_on_verified_trims.what: all 459k cached VIN decodes with a vPIC transmission (lot or not), corrected by _correct_vpic

not_manual_only.why: EPA lists the 2.0T HHR with a 4-speed automatic in every SS year.
EPA lists the 1.6T Elantra GT with a 7-speed dual-clutch (AM7 / AM-S7) as well as the 6-speed manual.

CVT (Sport Lineartronic) offered: EPA 'WRX Automatic (AV-S8)' rows.
6-speed TC-SST dual-clutch only (EPA Automatic (S6)/(AM6) rows every year).
CVT only (EPA 'Juke Nismo RS AWD' Automatic (AV-S8)).

not_manual_only.trim: Honda del Sol Si / Prelude Si / Accord Si
not_manual_only.why: Automatics offered; vPIC labels on the lots include automatics for del Sol Si and Prelude Si. Only the Civic Si (1999 on) is manual-only.
4-speed automatic offered with the 2.0 turbo from 1991 (EPA 7652); only 1990 was manual-only.
From 1991 the GTZ could have the 3.1 V6 with a 3-speed automatic.
